intent: Play a single video with custom playback controls (play/pause, seek, volume, speed, fullscreen).
avoid_when: embedding a video with no custom controls is enough (use a plain <video> element or provider embed)
a11y_contract: every icon-only control (play/pause, mute, seek, playback speed, fullscreen) has an explicit aria-label reflecting current state (e.g. "Pause" vs "Play", current playback speed); the seek and volume sliders are built on React Aria Slider so keyboard operation comes for free
requires_data: a video `src`; a `label` describing the video content for the control region
